publishedDeadlines.note: Annual; US applications continue until February 15.

applicationFee.note: Central graduate page permits financial-hardship waiver requests; international eligibility must be confirmed. Some departmental pages restrict waivers to named affiliated programs; department cannot waive directly.

english.note: Central scores valid within 2 years of entry; PTE 53, TOEFL Essentials 8.5 and other alternatives listed. Country-language and qualifying US degree/coursework exemptions may apply; confirm with program. No blanket English-medium exemption inferred.

requirements.note: Acceptance requires faculty willing to direct research. Statement names 2–3 faculty and research/career goals. Unofficial review records; official records sent from institutions. Spring July 1 annual. Department waiver FAQ names affiliations including EducationUSA Opportunity Funds; confirm route against central hardship policy.

funding.note: TA stipend and CAS tuition waiver; RA stipend/tuition from mentor grants. Available funding controls awards; not an all-funded guarantee.
